mapper.select: /* saleson.shop.notice.NoticeMapper.getNotice */ SELECT A.notice_id, A.subject, A.url, A.category_team, crypto_dec('normal', A.user_name, '', 0) AS user_name, A.password, A.email, A.content, A.hits, A.board_code, A.sub_category, A.created_date, A.target_option, A.rel_option, A.notice_flag, A.visible_type, A.seller_select_flag, A.use_yn FROM ( SELECT notice_id, subject, url, category_team, user_name, password, email, content, hits, board_code, sub_category, created_date, target_option, rel_option, notice_flag, visible_type, seller_select_flag, use_yn FROM op_notice WHERE notice_id = #{value} ) A

/* saleson.shop.notice.NoticeMapper.getSellerNotice */ SELECT A.notice_id, A.subject, A.url, A.category_team, crypto_dec('normal', A.user_name, '', 0) user_name, A.password, A.email, A.content, A.hits, A.board_code, A.sub_category, A.created_date, A.target_option, A.rel_option, A.notice_flag, A.visible_type, A.seller_select_flag FROM ( SELECT N.notice_id, N.subject, N.url, N.category_team, N.user_name, N.password, N.email, N.content, N.hits, N.board_code, N.sub_category, N.created_date, N.target_option, N.rel_option, N.notice_flag, N.visible_type, N.seller_select_flag FROM op_notice N LEFT JOIN op_notice_seller S ON N.notice_id=S.notice_id WHERE N.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND (S.seller_id=#{sellerId} OR N.seller_select_flag = 'N') ) A
mapper.update: /* saleson.shop.notice.NoticeMapper.updateNotice */ UPDATE OP_NOTICE SET SUBJECT = #{subject}, URL = #{url}, USER_NAME = crypto_enc('normal', #{userName},''), CONTENT = #{content}, TARGET_OPTION = #{targetOption}, REL_OPTION = #{relOption}, NOTICE_FLAG = #{noticeFlag}, VISIBLE_TYPE = #{visibleType}, SELLER_SELECT_FLAG = #{sellerSelectFlag}, USE_YN=#{useYn} WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}

/* saleson.shop.notice.NoticeMapper.getFrontNotice */ SELECT A.notice_id, A.subject, A.url, A.category_team, crypto_dec('normal', A.user_name, '', 0) as user_name, A.password, A.email, A.content, A.hits, A.board_code, A.sub_category, A.created_date, A.target_option, A.rel_option, A.notice_flag, A.visible_type, A.seller_select_flag, A.use_yn FROM ( SELECT notice_id, subject, url, category_team, user_name, password, email, content, hits, board_code, sub_category, created_date, target_option, rel_option, notice_flag, visible_type, seller_select_flag, use_yn FROM op_notice WHERE notice_id = #{value} AND use_yn = 'Y' ) A
